The dent specialists · Langley, BC

Repair the panel.
Protect what makes your finish original.

From parking-lot door dings to shallow creases and hail marks, Pacific Dentworks in Langley is a place to start when you want to explore a paintless repair option for your vehicle.

Paintless dent repair is designed to gently reshape suitable metal panels without sanding, fillers or repainting. Every dent needs an individual assessment.

  • Door dings
  • Creases
  • Hail dents
  • Minor impacts
Get a Free EstimateExplore Our Services

Why Consider Paintless Dent Repair?

  • Factory paint preserved

    For suitable dents where the factory paint is intact and the panel can be reshaped.

  • No sanding or repainting

    A PDR approach can avoid refinishing for damage that meets the right conditions.

  • An honest assessment

    Suitability depends on shape, depth, panel access and the paint surface.

  • Local Langley location

    Visit Pacific Dentworks in Langley or call to discuss the next step.

What we do

Our Paintless Dent Repair Services

Explore common types of damage that may be repairable while preserving your vehicle’s original paint.

Door Dings

A shopping-cart or car-door impact may be a PDR candidate when the paint is sound and the dent is accessible.

Learn More

Dents & Creases

Shallow creases can sometimes be carefully reshaped without conventional body filler or repainting.

Learn More

Hail Dents

Small hail impressions on roofs and hoods can be assessed for paintless correction.

Learn More

Minor Impacts

A low-speed bump may leave a localized dent suitable for careful paintless correction.
